title: Payment of certain sums by e-commerce operator to e-commerce participant

effectivePeriod.annualReset: Every April 1 (Cumulative Platform Sales Reset Annually)
effectivePeriod.sunsetNotes: Rate reduced from 1% to 0.1% w.e.f. 1 October 2024 by Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024. Transitions to Section 393(1) Table 8 Item (i) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 effective 1 April 2026.

plainTextSummary: Every e-commerce operator facilitating the sale of goods or provision of services through its digital or electronic platform must deduct income-tax at source on the gross amount of such sales or services credited or paid to a resident e-commerce participant. Statutory Rate: (a) 1.0% prior to 1 October 2024; (b) 0.1% on or after 1 October 2024 (as amended by Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024). In the absence of a valid PAN or where PAN is inoperative, tax is deductible at 5.0% under Section 206AA(1). De Minimis Exemption: No deduction is required if the participant is a resident Individual or HUF, the gross amount of sales/services through the operator does not exceed ₹5,00,000 in the financial year, and the participant has furnished their PAN/Aadhaar. Corporate, LLP, and partnership participants have zero threshold (TDS applies from ₹1). Section 194O has statutory precedence: transactions subject to Section 194O are exempt from Section 194Q buyer TDS and Section 206C(1H) seller TCS.

keyStatutoryThresholds.statutoryPrecedenceRule: Section 194O overrides Section 194Q and Section 206C(1H). Transactions subjected to 194O are exempt from buyer TDS and seller TCS.
keyStatutoryThresholds.taxableBaseScope: Deductible on gross amount of sales or provision of services facilitated by operator, including deemed direct purchaser-to-seller settlements.
